reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for yohimbine, or for any supplement or drug. Yohimbine is a stimulant that acts on the cardiovascular system and can interact with medications, so the right call, including whether it's appropriate for you at all, belongs to a doctor or a registered dietitian.

What I can do is the training and eating side of fat loss, which does most of the work. I can build you a program that fits your week, or set up calorie and macro targets in the app. Want me to start with either of those?
